news.headline: Wall Street tech rout: Nasdaq -2.86%, S&P 500 -1.82% on Friday
news.what_happened: US stocks closed October with a sharp tech-led selloff; Nasdaq fell to 25,437 and S&P 500 to 7,580. Cause not confirmed (AI cost worries reported earlier in the week).
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off cue for Indian large caps and IT services, with FII selling risk and a likely soft open.

news.headline: WTI crude -2.8% to ~$101, Brent ~$110.7
news.what_happened: WTI fell about 2.8% to $101.2 and Brent about 2.4% to $110.7 in Monday trade after a rise on Friday. Oil remains very elevated.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude eases input costs for airlines, tyres and paints, and is a partial offset to the weak global tape.

news.headline: Nifty ended Friday at 23,053 (+0.51%); IT and pharma led, midcaps and smallcaps slid
news.what_happened: Nifty 50 gained 116 pts to 23,053.10 and Sensex rose 308 pts to 74,459.53. Midcap index -0.8%, smallcap -1.8%.
news.why_it_matters: Nifty enters Monday near recent highs just as US markets sold off, so a gap-down and fade risk is elevated.

news.headline: Rupee firmer at ~94.94; gold +0.5%; Asia mixed
news.what_happened: USD/INR eased to 94.94 from 95.15. Gold rose to $3,919. Hang Seng +0.25%, Nikkei -0.3%.
news.why_it_matters: Slightly stronger rupee is a mild headwind for IT exporters; rising gold confirms a defensive tone.
